payload.explanation: The business request (session_00fb43718a8a, pid 1429) is blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_94abe0c68ad5 (pid 1432), which ran the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and is now 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead — an abandoned/uncommitted transaction holding the row lock. No evidence of large data, redundant indexes, or vacuum issues (single PK index, tiny table). Resolution: rollback_session on session_94abe0c68ad5, the eligible project-owned blocker, then the business request should complete. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
